Control Objective: Verify written authorization, scope, exclusions, contacts, stop conditions and reporting path.
Reference / Mapping Area: Planning and conducting technical security tests
Expected Evidence: Signed authorization; ROE; scope list; contacts; stop conditions
Safety / Manufacturing Consideration: OT production testing requires explicit owner/safety approval.

Control Objective: Establish accountable owners, risk governance and cybersecurity program responsibilities.
Expected Evidence: Policies; roles; risk register; governance records
Safety / Manufacturing Consideration: Include plant, OT and safety stakeholders.

Control Objective: Assess whether security risks are identified, treated and reviewed systematically.
Expected Evidence: ISMS scope; risk methodology; treatment records; review evidence
Safety / Manufacturing Consideration: Do not treat ISO certification as proof of technical security.

Control Objective: Identify ISA-95 levels, interfaces and trust boundaries.
Expected Evidence: Architecture diagrams; asset inventory; data-flow diagrams
Safety / Manufacturing Consideration: Avoid active probing of Level 0/1 without approval.

Control Objective: Assess OT security governance with performance, reliability and safety constraints.
Reference / Mapping Area: OT security architecture and risk guidance
Expected Evidence: OT security plan; architecture; procedures; test records
Safety / Manufacturing Consideration: Safety and availability take precedence over aggressive testing.

Control Objective: Assess asset-owner security program, lifecycle and security requirements.
Expected Evidence: Security program; risk assessment; zone/conduit model; supplier requirements
Safety / Manufacturing Consideration: Use defined security levels and safety constraints; do not infer certification from a test.

Control Objective: Identify known, unknown, unmanaged and externally exposed assets and owners.
Expected Evidence: Asset inventory; CMDB; discovery output; ownership records
Safety / Manufacturing Consideration: Passive discovery preferred in OT.

Asset Families: IT; Servers; Endpoints; Network; OT where supported
Control Objective: Identify, validate, prioritize and track vulnerabilities.
Expected Evidence: Scan reports; versions; validation notes; remediation tickets
Safety / Manufacturing Consideration: OT scanning requires vendor/asset-owner approval and safe profiles.

Control Objective: Assess insecure configurations against approved baselines.
Reference / Mapping Area: Control 4: Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
Expected Evidence: Baselines; config exports; deviations; exceptions
Safety / Manufacturing Consideration: Never apply hardening directly during assessment without change approval.

Control Objective: Assess unauthorized software, integrity controls and change detection.
Reference / Mapping Area: Application allowlisting; file integrity; software modification protection
Expected Evidence: Allowlist; FIM alerts; approved software list; change records
Safety / Manufacturing Consideration: Protect production binaries and controller programs from modification.

Control Objective: Assess account lifecycle, authentication, authorization, privileged access and service identities.
Expected Evidence: Account inventory; MFA config; role matrix; privileged session records
Safety / Manufacturing Consideration: Avoid lockout or service-account disruption.

Asset Families: VPN; RDP; SSH; Jump hosts; Vendor access
Control Objective: Assess secure remote access, MFA, authorization, segmentation and session control.
Expected Evidence: VPN configs; MFA evidence; jump-host logs; vendor access records
Safety / Manufacturing Consideration: Production remote access changes can affect availability; coordinate windows.

Asset Families: PAM; Admin accounts; Engineering stations; OT
Control Objective: Assess least privilege, separation of duties, privileged session controls and break-glass access.
Expected Evidence: Role matrix; PAM policy; session logs; break-glass procedure
Safety / Manufacturing Consideration: Protect operator and safety functions from privilege changes.

Control Objective: Assess zones, conduits, ACLs and permitted flows between trust boundaries.
Expected Evidence: Zone/conduit diagram; firewall rules; flow matrix; test results
Safety / Manufacturing Consideration: Do not introduce traffic that can disturb controllers or safety systems.

Asset Families: Modbus/TCP; OPC UA; EtherNet/IP; PROFINET; MQTT; DNP3; others
Control Objective: Identify exposed protocols, insecure services and unauthorized paths.
Expected Evidence: Protocol inventory; packet captures; service inventory
Safety / Manufacturing Consideration: Prefer passive inspection; no write/control commands in production.

Asset Families: Firewalls; Routers; OT gateways; Cloud security groups
Control Objective: Validate least-privilege network paths and management-plane exposure.
Expected Evidence: Rulesets; network diagrams; allowed-flow matrix; logs
Safety / Manufacturing Consideration: Coordinate tests crossing OT boundaries.

Asset Families: Web apps; Portals; Admin panels; cPanel
Control Objective: Assess common web application security risks and business access controls.
Expected Evidence: Requests/responses; auth evidence; configuration; sanitized screenshots
Safety / Manufacturing Consideration: Avoid destructive actions and real production transactions.

Asset Families: REST; SOAP; GraphQL; gRPC; WebSockets; IoT APIs
Control Objective: Assess API authorization, authentication, inventory, resource consumption and unsafe integrations.
Expected Evidence: OpenAPI/spec inventory; request/response evidence; authorization matrix
Safety / Manufacturing Consideration: Rate-limit tests and resource exhaustion tests must be bounded.

Asset Families: Web; API; ERP; MES; PLM; portals
Control Objective: Assess authentication failures, session management and MFA where applicable.
Expected Evidence: Auth flows; session evidence; MFA configuration
Safety / Manufacturing Consideration: Do not lock out production operator accounts.

Control Objective: Assess identities, roles, service accounts, keys, privilege and trust relationships.
Expected Evidence: IAM policies; role inventory; key age; trust policy evidence
Safety / Manufacturing Consideration: Never rotate/delete production credentials during assessment.

Control Objective: Assess segmentation, public exposure and control-plane access.
Reference / Mapping Area: Network infrastructure management and secure configuration safeguards
Expected Evidence: Topology; SG/NACL rules; public exposure report
Safety / Manufacturing Consideration: Avoid changing routing or firewall state during testing.

Asset Families: S3; Blob; data lakes; cloud DBs
Control Objective: Assess public exposure, access control, encryption, logging and data leakage.
Expected Evidence: Bucket/container policy; encryption config; access logs; sample non-sensitive data
Safety / Manufacturing Consideration: Use synthetic/non-sensitive data where possible.

Asset Families: PII; production; quality; CAD/IP; credentials; keys
Control Objective: Assess classification, access, retention, encryption, leakage and secure handling.
Expected Evidence: Data classification; access matrix; encryption evidence; DLP/log evidence
Safety / Manufacturing Consideration: Minimize collection and redact sensitive manufacturing/IP data.

Control Objective: Assess collection, access, retention and disclosure controls appropriate to applicable obligations.
Expected Evidence: Data inventory; privacy notices; retention records; access evidence
Safety / Manufacturing Consideration: Do not export unnecessary PII into assessment artifacts.

Asset Families: API keys; passwords; certificates; private keys; KMS
Control Objective: Assess secret storage, key lifecycle, certificate management and cryptographic protection.
Expected Evidence: Secret-store config; certificate inventory; TLS evidence; key lifecycle records
Safety / Manufacturing Consideration: Never expose private keys or real secrets in reports.

Asset Families: SIS; Safety PLC; interlocks; emergency functions
Control Objective: Assess cybersecurity controls around safety-related functions without unsafe manipulation.
Expected Evidence: Safety architecture; approvals; test constraints; evidence
Safety / Manufacturing Consideration: No safety-function manipulation in production unless explicitly engineered, approved and controlled.

Asset Families: PLC; PAC; RTU; HMI; SCADA; engineering stations
Control Objective: Assess authentication, configuration, firmware, remote access, program integrity and monitoring.
Expected Evidence: Controller inventory; firmware; configs; access logs; backups
Safety / Manufacturing Consideration: Default to read-only; use lab/digital twin for disruptive validation.

Control Objective: Assess visibility, event collection, detection logic and escalation for OT events.
Expected Evidence: Log sources; detection rules; alert evidence; escalation records
Safety / Manufacturing Consideration: Detection tests must not trigger unsafe plant responses.

Control Objective: Assess third-party access, security requirements, authorization, monitoring and offboarding.
Expected Evidence: Contracts; access matrix; vendor accounts; logs; offboarding records
Safety / Manufacturing Consideration: Vendor maintenance windows require plant approval.

Asset Families: Git; CI/CD; package registries; firmware update channels
Control Objective: Assess source integrity, dependency risk, build pipeline access, signing and update controls.
Reference / Mapping Area: Application software security and service-provider safeguards
Expected Evidence: Repo permissions; branch protections; SBOM; signing; build logs
Safety / Manufacturing Consideration: Do not alter release pipelines or firmware in production.

Control Objective: Assess logging coverage, integrity, retention, time synchronization and review.
Expected Evidence: Log source matrix; retention; timestamps; SIEM ingestion; sample alerts
Safety / Manufacturing Consideration: Ensure time synchronization evidence is interpreted in plant context.

Control Objective: Assess incident handling, escalation, containment and recovery coordination.
Reference / Mapping Area: RS.MA; RS.AN; RS.CO; RS.MI; RC.RP; RC.CO
Expected Evidence: IR plan; contacts; playbooks; exercise results; recovery evidence
Safety / Manufacturing Consideration: OT containment must account for safety, production and process state.

Asset Families: Servers; DB; PLC; SCADA; HMI; Engineering; Cloud
Control Objective: Assess backup integrity, offline/immutable copies, restoration and recovery objectives.
Assessment Mode: Document + restore test in approved environment
Expected Evidence: Backup inventory; restore evidence; RTO/RPO; golden images
Safety / Manufacturing Consideration: Prefer non-production restoration; protect operational continuity.

Asset Families: ERP; MES; production; safety; quality; utilities
Control Objective: Connect technical findings to production, safety, quality, recovery and business consequences.
Expected Evidence: BIA; critical process map; dependency matrix; impact rationale
Safety / Manufacturing Consideration: Safety and process impacts must be reviewed by responsible plant personnel.

Control Objective: Classify root weakness consistently and distinguish observation, vulnerability and control gap.
Expected Evidence: Finding record; CWE mapping rationale; evidence references
Safety / Manufacturing Consideration: CWE is a classification, not a severity score.

Control Objective: Score technical vulnerability characteristics and record environmental/contextual impact separately.
Expected Evidence: CVSS vector; score rationale; environmental factors
Safety / Manufacturing Consideration: For OT, record safety/recovery context; CVSS must not replace business/plant risk assessment.

Control Objective: Map observed attack paths or exposures to relevant ICS adversary tactics/techniques.

Safety / Manufacturing Consideration: Use mapping for context; do not infer compromise solely from a technique match.

Control Objective: Verify remediation claims with reproducible evidence and record residual risk.

Safety / Manufacturing Consideration: Retest in production only under approved conditions.

Control Objective: Verify security measures after testing and track remediation of findings.
Expected Evidence: Remediation tickets; retest evidence; updated controls
Safety / Manufacturing Consideration: Do not repeat unsafe OT actions simply to prove closure.
